anomalies.description: A dense, agitated crowd of people, many wearing white caps, is tightly packed and actively pushing against a line of black riot shields held by authorities (partially visible). Several individuals raise arms, gesture emphatically, and appear to be pressing forward; some hold sticks or poles. The scene shows sustained collective unrest with physical pressure against law enforcement barriers, consistent with a riotous confrontation rather than a peaceful protest.

A dense crowd of protesters, many wearing white caps, is tightly packed and actively pushing against a line of black riot shields held by security forces; individuals are raising arms, gesturing aggressively, and some appear to be attempting to breach the barrier, indicating collective violent unrest and physical confrontation.

Large crowd engaged in collective unrest with raised arms, pushing, and chaotic movement; some individuals appear to be clashing with unseen forces (e.g., barriers or security), consistent with violent protest dynamics.

In frame f3 (41.5s) and f4 (42.0s), two individuals in center-left are seen in close physical contact with aggressive postures—arms interlocked, bodies leaning into each other—suggesting mutual physical combat amid the crowd.
